title: DataFlowBench normalized result v1
description: One adapter run over one population: the witnessed tool identity, the bound configuration, and one normalized outcome per selected case, each backed by retained raw evidence.

schema_version.description: Normalized-result schema version. A freeze binds it as benchmark.result_schema_version and rejects a report at a different version.

tool.description: The analyzer this report is evidence for (e.g. bifrost, codeql, joern, semgrep, opentaint, infer, flowdroid, pysa).

tool_version.description: The pinned analyzer version, witnessed from the installed artifact by the run itself, never taken from a changelog. Release and website freezes reject placeholders such as unknown or n/a.

tool_build_identity.description: The build the run was actually pinned to (e.g. a CodeQL build SHA); read from the binary's own banner once per run, so it names something the run witnessed rather than an asserted pin.

adapter_version.description: Version of the DataFlowBench adapter that produced this report; also rejected as a placeholder on release and website freezes.

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 over the adapter's committed configuration — rules, queries, model files — so the report binds the rules, not just the tool. Any change to a bound configuration file changes this hash and invalidates prior evidence.

fixture_revision.description: sha256:-prefixed digest over the whole case corpus (every case file and every declared fixture, path and bytes). Reports at different fixture revisions are never pooled.

started_at_unix_seconds.description: Unix wall-clock start of the run. Provenance only — never an input to a correctness outcome or a published latency figure, which come from the monotonic-clock timing sidecars.

ended_at_unix_seconds.description: Unix wall-clock end of the run; provenance only, like started_at_unix_seconds.

cold_or_warm.description: Whether the run started from cold caches (fresh process or database per case, start-up cost inside the number) or reused warm state. Cold rows are the headline; a warm marginal cost is a separate, labelled figure never substituted for a cold one.

results.description: One record per selected case. A report covers exactly one adapter, one semantic track, one score dimension, and one model profile; a freeze rejects duplicate or incomplete result sets.

case_id.description: The id of the case this record answers; appears exactly once in the report.

outcome.description: The normalized state, the only five an adapter may emit. reached: anchor-backed evidence of the flow. not-reached: a successful run whose retained evidence shows no matching flow — an incomplete or failed run must never become not-reached merely because the finding list is empty. inconclusive: the tool ran but its evidence is unresolved or incomplete; decided after the run. unsupported: outside the tool's documented profile, decided from case metadata before the tool is invoked, and excluded from false-negative interpretation. runner-error: the invocation failed, with the raw failure evidence retained. The last three are coverage outcomes and are never converted into negatives.

source_anchors.description: The case's source anchors, copied verbatim; the normalizer copies, it does not re-derive.

sink_anchors.description: The case's sink anchors, copied verbatim, so a reader can check which finding was reconciled against which endpoint.

witness_checkpoints.description: Checkpoints the tool actually reported traversing — never synthesized from the case's expectations. Adapters that record only anchor-backed flow outcomes leave this empty and keep path evidence in the raw document.

diagnostics.description: Runner and tool diagnostics retained for audit, including capability-decision rationales and front-end maturity labels.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for this case from the runner's monotonic clock around the analyzer subprocesses the adapter owns. Additive metadata: no correctness outcome may read it.

peak_memory_mb.description: Peak resident memory in MiB, or null when the adapter cannot observe it.

raw_output.description: Repository-relative path to the retained raw evidence for this case — the tool's native document, a runner-error record, or a capability-decision document. Freeze validation digests the file and rejects a report claiming a clean not-reached over raw evidence that declares otherwise.
